base_branch_rationale: Wave B branches from the Batch 3 branch because core has no other open line and the operation registry it registers into lives there.

secondary_repositories.purpose: declare the two distributed capabilities in the G4.1 contract and regenerate specs/capabilities/registry.json

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: A declared, versioned environment profile listing host capabilities as present, absent or unknown, where unknown is absent; detection that reports a mismatch as a diagnostic and never overwrites a declaration; verification that fails closed naming every missing capability; the ordinary-hosting profile as first class; and diagnostics that name capabilities and never a path, a credential or a host.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: letting detection overwrite a declared value
putting a path, a credential, a host name or any secret into a diagnostic
adding a table or a migration
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/licensing, larena/storage or any package other than larena/core
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing core style; no database.
required_tests: a profile with unknown behaves exactly as with absent
detection reports a mismatch as a diagnostic carrying both values and changes no declared value
the ordinary-hosting profile validates and is marked first class
a package requiring a capability the profile lacks fails closed naming the capability
a package requiring a capability the profile declares unknown fails closed the same way
a diagnostic payload contains no path, credential, host name or secret
the environment fingerprint is stable for the same profile and differs for a different one
the four environment operations register in the core registry with no descriptor mismatch
smoke_plan: The doctor command reporting the environment profile on sqlite and mysql, and core:operations:coverage showing the environment codes as covered.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen capability key set, presence enum, profile shape or reason code would have to change
detection would have to write a declaration
a table or migration would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
The profile describes a host; it does not configure one.
The fingerprint this wave computes is what node admission compares, and nothing here admits a node.
